_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining climate data collected from various weather stations.

weatherdata._description: Records daily weather data at various airport stations.

columns.name: log_date
columns.description: Stores date strings in YYYY-MM-DD format for weather data records.

columns.name: time
columns.description: Stores time data in a 10-character format representing hours, minutes, and seconds (HH:mm:ss).

columns.name: station
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for weather stations.

columns.name: temp
columns.description: Stores air temperature values in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.

columns.name: humidity
columns.description: Stores air humidity levels as floating point values, typically between 0.0 and 100.0.

columns.name: airpressure
columns.description: Stores atmospheric air pressure readings in millibars.

columns.name: wind
columns.description: Stores average wind speed (in mph) for each weather data record.

columns.name: weather
columns.description: Stores weather conditions described as "Schneefall" (snowfall) in this database.

columns.name: winddirection
columns.description: Stores wind direction values in degrees (e.g., 254 represents 167 degrees).
